#### Native C++ route

The recipe above prototypes a reconstruction in Python and selects a built-in one by name. A new scheme that the
solver itself runs is a C++ class, built into the library and selected from the YAML card. Each step below is a
fact of the code at the pin.

**Select it from YAML.** A reconstruction is read from `dynamics/reconstruct/vertical` for $x_1$ and from
`dynamics/reconstruct/horizontal` for $x_2$ and $x_3$ ([`src/hydro/hydro_options.cpp:24-27`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/hydro/hydro_options.cpp#L24-L27)). Each section takes `shock`, `type` and
`scale`; `type` defaults to `dc` ([`src/recon/reconstruct.cpp:31-36`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/recon/reconstruct.cpp#L31-L36)):

```cpp
  check_keys(node[section], "dynamics/reconstruct/" + section,
             {"shock", "type", "scale"});
  op->shock() = node[section]["shock"].as<bool>(false);
  op->interp() = InterpOptionsImpl::create();
  op->interp()->type() = node[section]["type"].as<std::string>("dc");
  op->interp()->scale() = node[section]["scale"].as<bool>(false);
```

A Riemann solver is read from `dynamics/riemann-solver`, whose keys are `type` and `dir` ([`src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp:18-19`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp#L18-L19)).
A section without `type` gives `roe` ([`src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp:27-28`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp#L27-L28)):

```cpp
  op->type() = node["type"].as<std::string>("roe");
  op->dir() = node["dir"].as<std::string>("omni");
```

A card with no such section keeps the options as created ([`src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp:17`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp#L17)), whose default is another solver,
`hllc` ([`src/riemann/riemann_solver.hpp:33`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/riemann/riemann_solver.hpp#L33)):

```cpp
  if (!config[section]["riemann-solver"]) return op;
  ADD_ARG(std::string, type) = "hllc";
```

**Lookup.** The name is compared as a string, branch by branch, in `InterpImpl::create` and
`RiemannSolverImpl::create`; there is no table and no suffix added to the name. A name with no branch is refused
when the block is built ([`src/recon/interpolation.cpp:38`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/recon/interpolation.cpp#L38), [`src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp:69`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp#L69)):

```cpp
    TORCH_CHECK(false, "Interp: unknown type " + opts->type());
    TORCH_CHECK(false, "RiemannSolver: unknown type " + opts->type());
```

A reconstruction module is created twice, under the names `interp1` and `interp2` ([`src/recon/reconstruct.cpp:75-76`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/recon/reconstruct.cpp#L75-L76)):

```cpp
  pinterp1 = InterpImpl::create(options->interp(), this, "interp1");
  pinterp2 = InterpImpl::create(options->interp(), this, "interp2");
```

and for `weno3` and `weno5` the last character of that name chooses the class ([`src/recon/interpolation.cpp:29-36`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/recon/interpolation.cpp#L29-L36)):

```cpp
  } else if (opts->type() == "weno5") {
    if (name.back() == '1') {
      return p->register_module(name, Weno5Interp(opts));
    } else if (name.back() == '2') {
      return p->register_module(name, Center5Interp(opts));
```

**Write the class.** The header `src/recon/interpolation.hpp` declares `InterpImpl`, the base of every
reconstruction. Its `forward` sizes the two outputs from `stencils()` and fills them through `left` and `right`
([`src/recon/interpolation.hpp:60-76`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/recon/interpolation.hpp#L60-L76)):

```cpp
  virtual std::pair<torch::Tensor, torch::Tensor> forward(
      torch::Tensor w, int dim,
      torch::optional<torch::Tensor> wl = torch::nullopt,
      torch::optional<torch::Tensor> wr = torch::nullopt) {
    auto vec = w.sizes().vec();
    vec[dim] -= stencils() - 1;  // reduce size by stencils - 1

    auto wlv = wl.value_or(torch::empty(vec, w.options()));
    auto wrv = wr.value_or(torch::empty(vec, w.options()));

    left(w, dim, wlv);
    right(w, dim, wrv);

    wl = wlv;
    wr = wrv;
    return std::make_pair(wlv, wrv);
  }
```

The donor-cell class is the smallest one to follow ([`src/recon/interpolation.hpp:88-107`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/recon/interpolation.hpp#L88-L107)):

```cpp
class DonorCellInterpImpl : public torch::nn::Cloneable<DonorCellInterpImpl>,
                            public InterpImpl {
 public:
  //! Constructor to initialize the layer
  DonorCellInterpImpl() = default;
  explicit DonorCellInterpImpl(InterpOptions const& options_)
      : InterpImpl(options_) {
    reset();
  }
  void reset() override {}
  using InterpImpl::forward;

  void left(torch::Tensor w, int dim, torch::Tensor const& out) override {
    out.copy_(w.slice(dim, 0, w.size(dim)));
  }
  void right(torch::Tensor w, int dim, torch::Tensor const& out) override {
    out.copy_(w.slice(dim, 0, w.size(dim) - 1));
  }
};
TORCH_MODULE(DonorCellInterp);
```

A Riemann solver derives from `RiemannSolverImpl`, declared in `src/riemann/riemann_solver.hpp`
([`src/riemann/riemann_solver.hpp:97-117`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/riemann/riemann_solver.hpp#L97-L117)):

```cpp
class RoeSolverImpl : public torch::nn::Cloneable<RoeSolverImpl>,
                      public RiemannSolverImpl {
 public:
  //! Constructor to initialize the layers
  RoeSolverImpl() = default;
  explicit RoeSolverImpl(const RiemannSolverOptions& options_,
                         torch::nn::Module* p = nullptr)
      : RiemannSolverImpl(options_, p) {
    reset();
  }
  void reset() override;

  //! Solver the Riemann problem
  torch::Tensor forward(torch::Tensor wl, torch::Tensor wr, int dim,
                        torch::Tensor out,
                        torch::Tensor face_pressure = torch::Tensor()) override;

 protected:
  FORWARD_HAS_DEFAULT_ARGS({4, torch::nn::AnyValue(torch::Tensor())})
};
TORCH_MODULE(RoeSolver);
```

Add one branch to the matching `create`, as for `roe` ([`src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp:56-57`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp#L56-L57)):

```cpp

    return p->register_module(name, RoeSolver(opts, p));
```

**Files.** Every `.cpp` file in `src/recon/` and `src/riemann/` is compiled into the library
([`src/CMakeLists.txt:42-43`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/CMakeLists.txt#L42-L43)), and with CUDA every `.cu` file there ([`src/CMakeLists.txt:128-129`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/CMakeLists.txt#L128-L129)); a new file there needs no CMake edit.

**Shapes, outputs and device.**

- Reconstruction output: the result is allocated like the input, so it has the input's dtype and device, and the
  method writes into it ([`src/recon/reconstruct.cpp:83`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/recon/reconstruct.cpp#L83)):

  ```cpp
    auto result = torch::zeros(vec, w.options());
  ```

- Riemann call: the solver gets the left and right states from the reconstruction, each of the shape of the state
  (the result above is the state's shape with 2 prepended), the direction, and the flux tensor to fill
  ([`src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp:487`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L487)):

  ```cpp
        priemann->forward(wlr1[ILT], wlr1[IRT], DIM1, _flux1, face_pressure1);
  ```

- In place, one dtype: the solver writes the flux into its fourth argument without resizing it, and all tensors
  must share one dtype ([`src/riemann/roe.cpp:42-53`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/riemann/roe.cpp#L42-L53)):

  ```cpp
    auto iter = at::TensorIteratorConfig()
                    .resize_outputs(false)
                    .check_all_same_dtype(true)
                    .declare_static_shape(flx.sizes(), /*squash_dims=*/0)
                    .add_output(flx)
                    .add_owned_output(face_pressure_out.unsqueeze(0))
                    .add_input(wl)
                    .add_input(wr)
                    .add_input(elr)
                    .add_input(glr)
                    .add_input(clr)
                    .build();
  ```

- Device: the kernel is chosen by the device of the flux tensor ([`src/riemann/roe.cpp:55`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/riemann/roe.cpp#L55)):

  ```cpp
    at::native::call_roe(flx.device().type(), iter, dim, ideal_moist, nvapor,
  ```

- Ownership: `create` registers the new module as a submodule of its parent with `register_module`
  ([`src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp:56-57`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp#L56-L57)); the solver keeps only a non-owning pointer back to its hydro ([`src/riemann/riemann_solver.hpp:64-65`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/src/riemann/riemann_solver.hpp#L64-L65)):

  ```cpp
    //! non-owning reference to parent
    HydroImpl const* phydro = nullptr;
  ```

**Rebuild.** Build the library ([`README.md:96-97`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/README.md#L96-L97)) and reinstall the Python package ([`README.md:100-102`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5/README.md#L100-L102)):

```bash
cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DNETCDF=ON
cmake --build build --parallel 3
pip install .
```

Then set the new name as `type` under `dynamics/reconstruct/vertical` or `horizontal`, or under
`dynamics/riemann-solver`.
